geography: Worldwide (Pfizer's Worldwide column; labelled 'Inflectra/Remsima' through the 2022Q1 release and 'Inflectra' from 2022Q2)

approval_evidence.quote: in September 2013, the European Commission approved Inflectra TM for multiple indications, specifically, the treatment of inflammatory conditions including rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, psoriatic arthritis and psoriasis

approval_evidence_us.quote: Application (BLA) : 125544 Company: CELLTRION INC ... INFLECTRA INFLIXIMAB-DYYB 100MG ... 04/05/2016 ORIG-1 Approval

launch_evidence.quote: Additionally, Hospira's third biosimilar, Inflectra™ was launched in Europe during 2013 into several early-launch countries.

series_start_reason: Inflectra was launched by Hospira, Inc. (CIK 1274057) in Europe in 2013; Hospira's 10-K/10-Q filings 2013-2015 (all fetched) never print Inflectra sales on their own line. Pfizer acquired Hospira on September 3, 2015 (Pfizer 10-Q filed 2015-11-05: 'On September 3, 2015 (the acquisition date), we acquired Hospira, Inc. (Hospira) for approximately $16.0 billion in cash.'). Pfizer first prints the line in the 2016Q4 release, whose prior-year columns give 2015Q4 (30) and whose twelve-months row gives full-year 2015 = 30, so 2015Q4 is the first Pfizer quarter with Inflectra revenue; 2016Q1-Q3 come from the prior-year columns of the 2017Q1-Q3 releases. Launch quarter 2013Q4 is inferred: the EC approved Inflectra in September 2013, Hospira's 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2013 (filed 2013-11-06) still says 'it will be launched throughout Europe at the earliest opportunity', and the 2013 10-K says it 'was launched in Europe during 2013'. 2015Q4 is 8 quarters after 2013Q4.

Searched all of them for table rows starting with Retacrit, Ruxience, Zirabev, Inflectra, Trumenba, Nimenrix, Vyndamax/Vyndaqel.
Hospira (CIK 1274057): listed and fetched every 10-K/10-Q 2013-2015 and every item-2.02 8-K exhibit 2013-2015; no table row carries an Inflectra (or Retacrit) figure.
